title: CI Test Reliability Assessment V1
description: Versioned schema for CI reliability (workflow failure rate / Playwright flaky test rate / Playwright terminal failure rate) non-inferiority assessments, defined independently from CI_TEST_PERFORMANCE_ASSESSMENT_V2 (schemas/ci_test_performance_assessment_v2.schema.json), which covers latency/performance only and is not modified by this schema. See docs/dev/ci-test-reliability-assessment.md for term definitions (denominators, retry vs rerun semantics, non-inferiority method). raw_attempts carries the raw per-run / per-test evidence that .claude/skills/ci-test-performance/scripts/validate_ci_reliability_assessment_v1.py recomputes reliability_metrics and non_inferiority_evaluation from; self-reported aggregates alone are never trusted.

reliability_metrics.description: Self-reported aggregates for the before (baseline) and after (candidate) cohorts. Recomputed and cross-checked against raw_attempts by the semantic validator -- never trusted alone.

sample_identity.description: Reliability's independent sample unit is workflow_run_id at run_attempt 1 (attempt-1 terminal outcome). GitHub Actions reruns (run_attempt > 1) are recorded in raw_attempts but are never counted as additional independent samples.

workflow_failure_rate.description: numerator = terminal failure workflow run count (conclusion == failure, run_attempt == 1). denominator = eligible unique workflow_run_id count (run_attempt == 1, conclusion in {success, failure}; cancelled/timed_out/action_required are excluded from both numerator and denominator as infrastructure failure, not counted as terminal failure).

playwright_flaky_test_rate.description: numerator = logical tests (run_attempt == 1) whose final Playwright retry attempt passed after at least one earlier attempt failed/timedOut/interrupted. denominator = executed logical tests (run_attempt == 1, final attempt status != skipped).

playwright_terminal_failure_rate.description: numerator = logical tests (run_attempt == 1) whose final Playwright retry attempt is failed/timedOut/interrupted (all retries exhausted, still failing). denominator = same as playwright_flaky_test_rate.

SampleCountRule.description: Must be explicit about whether the sample size is power-derived; a fixed sample count of 20 is never a silent default (see Background in issue #2170 -- 0/20 runs still leaves a ~16.8% two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound -- the corresponding one-sided 95% upper bound is ~13.9%; see non_inferiority_evaluation.sidedness / risk_difference for the authoritative one-sided two-sample non-inferiority test).

NonInferiorityEvaluation.description: Non-inferiority judgment for target_metric. before/after are per-arm two-sided exact (Clopper-Pearson) intervals reported for audit only (so a 0-failure before cohort still shows a finite, non-zero upper bound) and are NOT the basis for outcome. outcome is derived solely from risk_difference: a genuine two-independent-proportions one-sided test of p_after - p_before (effect_measure), computed via the Newcombe/Wilson hybrid score (MOVER) method. Both before and after must individually meet sample_count_rule.required_sample_count or outcome is inconclusive.

interval_method.description: Method used ONLY for the per-arm audit intervals in before/after (two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson). NOT the method used to derive outcome -- see risk_difference.method.

effect_measure.description: The two-independent-proportions effect measure used for the non-inferiority hypothesis test (p_after - p_before). Distinct from the per-arm audit-only Clopper-Pearson intervals in before/after.

sidedness.description: The non-inferiority hypothesis test (risk_difference.ci_upper vs non_inferiority_margin) is one-sided. This is independent of interval_method's before/after audit intervals, which are two-sided (see IntervalEstimate description).

IntervalEstimate.description: Per-arm two-sided exact (Clopper-Pearson) interval for a single binomial proportion, reported for audit/reporting only. NOT the basis for non_inferiority_evaluation.outcome -- see risk_difference for the authoritative one-sided two-sample test.

WorkflowRunAttempt.description: One GitHub Actions workflow run attempt. run_attempt 1 is the independent reliability sample; run_attempt > 1 is a GitHub Actions rerun, recorded here but never counted as an additional sample (see sample_identity).

PlaywrightLogicalTestRun.description: One logical Playwright test as executed within a single workflow_run_id/run_attempt. attempts is Playwright's own internal retry sequence (retries config), which is distinct from a GitHub Actions workflow rerun (a separate PlaywrightLogicalTestRun entry with a different run_attempt).

PlaywrightTestAttempt.description: One Playwright internal retry attempt. expected_status (optional) mirrors Playwright's own expectedStatus (e.g. for test.fail()); when absent, expected_status defaults to 'passed' for classification purposes (preserves prior behavior for producers that do not emit it).

RiskDifferenceEstimate.description: One-sided upper confidence bound for the two-independent-proportions risk difference p_after - p_before, computed via the Newcombe/Wilson hybrid score (MOVER) method (stdlib-only, no scipy/statsmodels). Authoritative for non_inferiority_evaluation.outcome. point_estimate/ci_upper are null when outcome is inconclusive (either arm below sample_count_rule.required_sample_count).

ci_upper.description: One-sided upper bound at confidence_level for p_after - p_before. Compared against non_inferiority_margin to derive outcome.
